newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.779 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.779 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves fell $121 million, or 0.76 percent, in the week to May 12 to $15.779 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were down from $15.900 billion on May 5, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.

Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $600 million, or 3.9 percent. Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
